description.en: Pambdelurion whittingtoni: whole living environment prop. Nominal 1.0m art envelope. Composite MGUH24514 trunk flaps, MGUH30506 anterior, MGUH30507 trunk; 2014 Fig6g whole schematic is not complete fossil. Eleven paired upper flaps and lower short lobopods are an inferred count; depth, muted clay palette, pose, terminal shape and spacing artistic. Internal glands not external.
